warnings: Smoking is encoded as lifetime 100+ cigarettes, not current smoking status. Former/current smoker implies this lifetime threshold; confirm it in the frontend.
limitations: Research prototype, not a validated diagnostic tool or a substitute for medical assessment.
Scores estimate associations with self-reported previous diagnoses, not future disease onset.
Uncalibrated model scores; positive weighting can materially alter probability calibration.
Cross-sectional measurements may follow diagnosis, treatment or lifestyle changes; contributions are not causal.
Unweighted NHANES sample evaluation is not a US population estimate; survey design is not modeled.
Complete-label selection, missing measurements, small positive counts and US sampling limit generalization.
explanation_method: Exact grouped interventional Shapley values on model-score scale
explanation_limitations: Training-background associations, not causal effects. Mixed feature coalitions may be physiologically implausible or outside the data distribution.
